claims.claim: union + dedupe of two real top-1M popularity lists (Cisco Umbrella + Majestic Million) yields 1,914,915 unique widely-used domains, ranked most-used first
holding is ~2 KB/site (3.92 GB for 1,914,915 sites) - capacity is not the wall; 60% of this 31.7 GB machine would hold ~9.3M sites, only FLOWING them needs O(1) search (T67)
nearest-centroid routing works across the merged lists: querying a famous site returns its real web neighbors
OUTAGE SURVIVED: the 20% random outage leaves 1,531,932 survivors routed with no repair unit
the internet net persists as a reusable checkpoint and reloads with bit-identical routing (q identical)

verdict: SUPPORTED (measured): the union of two real top-1M popularity lists fills the net with ~1.91M widely-used sites, routes them by nearest-centroid, survives the outage, and persists as a reusable checkpoint that reloads bit-identically - capacity is not the wall, flow is (T67 unlocks it)
